verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community reports describing real-time, no-refresh syncing of teammates' changes across open sessions (e.g., live cursors, instant issue updates, presence). References to webhooks (linear-docs-51/52) describe external HTTP push notifications for integrations, not in-app live UI updates, and speed-related comments (linear-comm-6) address load times, not multi-session sync.
